facts.fact: The Prime Minister said the government allocated more than TZS 132bn in the 2026/27 financial year to the National Identification Authority (NIDA) for development projects, including 31 registration offices, a headquarters building and an ICT service centre.

note: The NIDA amount is a national ID agency's development vote, not a digital ministry or agency by name; the parent may judge whether it counts. Date is the speech day, the day before the 17 Sep report.
